description: Refactor the legacy `AnalyticsService` class in the `user-analytics` project. Replace all imperative `for` loops in the methods `findActiveUsers`, `getEmailsOfPremiumUsers`, `countLoginsByRegion`, and `hasUserWithId` with Java Stream API pipelines. The refactored code must be cleaner, functional, and must pass all existing unit tests. Do not modify the test files.
